sponsored.t: Relates to setting integrated behavioral health services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of the office of mental health, and the office of addiction services and support to jointly establish a single set of licensing standards and requirements for the construction, operation, reporting and surveillance of integrated behavioral health services.

sponsored.t: Requires issuers of credit cards to give the cardholder at least thirty days notice before closing, cancelling, or terminating the cardholder's account
sponsored.sum: Requires issuers of credit cards to give the cardholder at least thirty days written notice via email, text message, or written letter before closing, cancelling, or terminating the cardholder's account.

sponsored.t: Authorizes full-time college students to act as election inspectors and poll clerks in the election district where their colleges are located
sponsored.sum: Authorizes, under certain circumstances, full-time college and university students to act as election inspectors and poll clerks in the election district where their college or university is located.

sponsored.t: Requires schools to follow seizure action plans developed by health care providers of students diagnosed with a seizure disorder
sponsored.sum: Requires public schools to follow seizure action plans developed by health care providers of students diagnosed with a seizure disorder; requires schools to provide seizure awareness training to certain employees on the recognition of signs and symptoms of a seizure and the appropriate steps to be taken to respond to such symptoms.

sponsored.t: Relates to fair pricing for low-complexity, routine medical care
sponsored.sum: Relates to fair pricing for low-complexity, routine medical care to more closely align payment rates across ambulatory settings for selected services that are safe and appropriate to provide in all settings.

sponsored.t: Encourages the participation of minority and women-owned business enterprises in state contracts
sponsored.sum: Encourages the participation of minority- and women-owned business enterprises in state contracts by avoiding unnecessary and unjustified bundling of contract requirements that preclude minority- and women-owned business participation.

sponsored.t: Requires appearance enhancement business and cosmetology licensees and trainees to disclose the price of cosmetology services
sponsored.sum: Requires appearance enhancement business and cosmetology licensees and trainees to disclose the price of cosmetology services both verbally and through signage.

sponsored.t: Ensures diversity and inclusion at certain state entities and combats harassment and discrimination in the workplace
sponsored.sum: Establishes the committee for diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity, the office of diversity management, and the state workforce diversity and inclusions council to ensure diversity and inclusion at certain state entities and combat harassment and discrimination in the workplace.

sponsored.t: Requires instruction on nutrition in schools
sponsored.sum: Requires instruction on nutrition in schools at all grades.

sponsored.t: Includes a component on water safety in kindergarten through twelfth grade
sponsored.sum: Includes a component on water safety in kindergarten through twelfth grade.

sponsored.t: Establishes minority youth-owned business enterprises
sponsored.sum: Establishes minority youth-owned business enterprises in the state of New York and the city of New York; creates certain contracting opportunities for members of minority youth-owned business enterprises; establishes an implementation program and oversight committee for minority youth-owned business enterprises.

sponsored.t: Relates to the age of persons enrolled in certain large group policies who receive annual mammograms
sponsored.sum: Reduces the age from 35 to 30 for a covered person's annual mammogram for persons enrolled in large group policies.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance coverage for lactation consultant services
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance coverage for lactation support services by a certified lactation consultant who evaluate and manage lactation and infant feeding problems and provide preventative clinical consulting to prevent or minimize the occurrence of potential problems.

sponsored.t: Relates to hospital care for mastectomy, lumpectomy, and lymph node dissection patients
sponsored.sum: Requires that general hospitals that provide mastectomy surgery, lymph node dissection or lumpectomy provide information to such patients concerning options for breast reconstruction.

sponsored.t: Permits courts to award punitive damages against an estate for sexual abuse
sponsored.sum: Permits courts to award punitive damages against an estate for sexual abuse.

sponsored.t: Relates to cargo bicycles with electric assist
sponsored.sum: Adds cargo bicycles with electric assist to the types of bicycles with electric assist regulated under the vehicle and traffic law; provides that no person shall operate a cargo bicycle with electric assist unless it is accompanied by proof of financial security unless otherwise authorized by local law, ordinance, order, rule, or regulation or pursuant to an agreement made on behalf of the city, town, or village.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting on swimming education in a public school
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of education to make a report on the extent of all existing resources and best practices available for swimming instruction classes in public schools and establish a working group on swimming education.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing additional requirements to purchase a firearm, shotgun or rifle
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing additional requirements to purchase a firearm, shotgun or rifle; requires a person to apply for a hunting license prior to the purchase of a shotgun or rifle; establishes additional requirements for all firearms, shotguns and rifles including taking a five hour gun safety course and exam, passing a shooting range test with 90% accuracy, providing notarized proof of a passed drug test and mental health evaluation, providing proof of purchase of firearm and ammunition safe storage depositories and passing a criminal background check.

sponsored.t: Provides voters an opportunity to cure deficiencies regarding affidavit ballots
sponsored.sum: Provides voters an opportunity to cure deficiencies regarding affidavit ballots in order to have their votes counted.

sponsored.t: Prohibits corrections employees from participating in degrading behavior towards incarcerated persons or fellow employees
sponsored.sum: Prohibits corrections employees from participating in degrading behavior towards incarcerated persons or fellow employees; establishes any individual who participates in such behavior shall be disciplined by the department and may have their employment terminated for cause.

sponsored.t: Requires the Department of Homeless Services to notify the affected community board prior to locating transitional housing for the homeless
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring the Department of Homeless Services to notify the affected community board prior to locating transitional housing for the homeless; requires written notification sixty days before the department enters into a contractual arrangement with a transitional housing provider or otherwise finalizes its decision to use or expand a location as transitional housing.

sponsored.t: Sets standards for addiction professionals
sponsored.sum: Relates to the scope of responsibilities of the office of addiction services and supports; defines addiction professional.

sponsored.t: Prohibits motor vehicle stops for certain violations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits motor vehicle stops for secondary violations, including certain violations relating to vehicle registration, equipment, and inspection.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of various programs for students in pre-kindergarten through third grade
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of various programs for students in pre-kindergarten through third grade including programs for literacy, career readiness and financial literacy.

sponsored.t: Requires that a defendant must be over twenty-five years old to be guilty of felony murder
sponsored.sum: Requires that a defendant must be over twenty-five years old to be guilty of felony murder.

sponsored.t: Includes policies and procedures for responding to students having mental health crises in school safety plans
sponsored.sum: Includes policies and procedures for responding to students having mental health crises in a manner that does not include contacting law enforcement unless implied or direct threats of violence or other criminal activity is involved in school safety plans.

sponsored.t: Requires the use of body-worn cameras on certain correction officers
sponsored.sum: Requires the use of body-worn cameras on certain correction officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting voting rights expansion act; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to voting rights expansion, voter registration on election day, expansion of the use of and requirements for absentee voting, creation of a real-time statewide voter registration database, special ballots for election employees, and voter affidavits.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring consent of a minor's parent, legal guardian or attorney for law enforcement collection of DNA from certain minors
sponsored.sum: Requires the written consent of a minor's parent, legal guardian or attorney for law enforcement collection of DNA from a minor and/or pick up of a discarded sample of a minor prior to the lawful arrest of such minor.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the superintendent of financial services to oversee and regulate car dealer transactions with consumers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the superintendent of financial services to oversee and regulate car dealer transactions with consumers; requires motor vehicle retail installment contracts to include an itemized listing of all costs related to the purchase of a motor vehicle and disclosure of the prohibition of conditional delivery; requires motor vehicle dealers to provide credit applicants with copies of all credit application documents; prohibits the conditional delivery of a motor vehicle.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state violence in mass media research program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state violence in mass media research program to study the effects of mass media reporting on violent crimes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of the emergency financial relief fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of the emergency financial relief fund to provide financial relief to federal employees or employees of federal contractors who are residents of New York state and required to work without compensation or placed on unpaid leave as a result of a lapse in appropriations by the United States government beginning on or after December 22, 2024; provides financial relief to non-profit organizations licensed to do business in New York state, with a contract to provide services to the federal government, and that are not providing such services as a result of such lapse in appropriations.

sponsored.t: Relates to notification and hearings for proposed construction or removal of bicycle lanes or racks
sponsored.sum: Relates to notification and hearings for proposed construction or removal of bicycle lanes or racks; requires a presentation at a public hearing when the department of transportation proposes to construct or remove a bicycle lane or rack; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the making equitable and alternative lunches (MEAL) act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "making equitable and alternative lunches (MEAL) act"; requires a public school to offer a plant-based food option, a halal food option and a kosher food option as an alternative to every meal or snack offered in food service to any student who chooses such alternative meal or snack as an option.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Drink Up Act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Drink Up Act"; requires every public school to offer water in a sealed bottled container as an additional drink option to any student during lunch at no cost to such student.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting certain suicide prevention and mental health services hotlines from being automated
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the office of mental health to promulgate rules and regulations prohibiting any suicide prevention or mental health services hotline operated or sponsored by the state from being automated.

sponsored.t: Creates a civil cause of action for the manufacture, sale, or distribution of assault weapons or ghost guns within the state
sponsored.sum: Creates a civil cause of action for the manufacture, sale, or distribution of assault weapons or ghost guns within the state; aiding and abetting such manufacture, sale or distribution; or intending to aid and abet in such manufacture, sale or distribution; provides for a civil remedy of ten thousand dollars per violation.

sponsored.t: Requires third party oversight over the state's contracting agency's procurement procedure
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring third party oversight over the state's contracting agency's procurement procedure specific to the use of minority- and women-owned businesses.

sponsored.t: Directs the assignment of a personal identification number to each application for acceptance to the state university and the city university
sponsored.sum: Provides that each state and city college or university assign a personal identification number to each application for acceptance to be used during the admissions process in place of any other identifying information including names and addresses.

sponsored.t: Requires certain locations and venues maintain a supply of opioid antagonists
sponsored.sum: Requires nightlife establishments, sporting or event centers, theaters, concert venues, and amusement parks maintain a supply of opioid antagonists.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the manufacture, sale, and use of cookware containing polytetrafluoroethylene
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the manufacture, sale, and use of cookware containing polytetrafluoroethylene.

sponsored.t: Prohibits rental vehicle companies from imposing any fees, charges or penalties, other than the actual cost of a toll, on an authorized driver for such driver's use of a rental vehicle
sponsored.sum: Prohibits rental vehicle companies from imposing any fees, charges or penalties, other than the actual cost of a toll, on an authorized driver for such driver's use of a rental vehicle.

sponsored.t: Relates to grand jury proceedings
sponsored.sum: Provides that in grand jury proceedings when following submission to a grand jury of a criminal charge or charges, the grand jury dismisses all charges presented or directs the district attorney to dismiss all charges or directs the DA to file in a local criminal court an application for disclosure of certain materials; authorizes the court to limit disclosure of certain items where there is a reasonable likelihood that such disclosure may lead to the identity of a witness who is not a public servant or expert witness; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the manufacture, sale, and use of wire grill brushes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the manufacture, sale, and use of wire grill brushes.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a judicial diversion program for young defendants
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a judicial diversion program for young defendants.

sponsored.t: Prohibits single-agent dual agency, requires representation agreements, and prohibits mandatory broker's fees in residential real property transactions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits single-agent dual agency; requires representation agreements; allows broker's fee negotiations; prohibits mandatory broker's fees in residential real property transactions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of foods and beverages containing chlormequat
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of foods and beverages containing chlormequat, also known as 2-chloro-N,N,N-trimethylethan-1-aminium.

sponsored.t: Requires annual audits of statewide opioid settlements
sponsored.sum: Requires annual audits of the use of statewide opioid settlement funds by the office of alcoholism and substance abuse.

sponsored.t: Provides for the appointment of foreclosure receivers and managing agents in N.Y. city
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Provides for the appointment of foreclosure receivers and managing agents in cities having a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers and duties of the commission on forensic science regarding familial DNA search regulations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of the state DNA identification index for familial DNA searches.

sponsored.t: Relates to undisposed cases
sponsored.sum: Provides that when the division of criminal justice services conducts a search of its criminal history records and returns a report thereon, all references to undisposed cases shall be excluded.

sponsored.t: Relates to the Chisholm Chance Act; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the Chisholm Chance Act; creates centers of pregnant and birthing persons and childcare services in Kings county and Bronx county to coordinate community-based organizations and community health workers to combat the pregnant and birthing persons health crisis.

sponsored.t: Provides for tenant responses to applications for a major capital improvement rent increase
sponsored.sum: Provides for tenant responses to applications for a major capital improvement rent increase; allows tenants to respond within one hundred twenty days from the date of mailing of a notice of a proceeding; requires the state division of housing and community renewal to provide any responding tenant with the reasons for the division's approval or denial of such application.

sponsored.t: Establishes fetal and infant mortality review boards
sponsored.sum: Establishes fetal and infant mortality review boards to study fetal and infant mortality and morbidity and make recommendations on policies, best practices, and strategies to reduce fetal and infant mortality and morbidity.

sponsored.t: Authorizes vocational training, where practicable, to incarcerated individuals on the installation of solar hot water systems for the provision of hot water to correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes vocational training, where practicable, to incarcerated individuals on the installation of solar hot water systems for the provision of hot water to correctional facilities.

sponsored.t: Increases salaries for foster care direct care workers; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Increases salaries for foster care direct care workers; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Requires all schools have a calming space for students
sponsored.sum: Requires all schools have a calming space for students for praying, meditating, and calming themselves.

sponsored.t: Provides for a sex offender registry check for youth organization volunteers who have direct contact with youths under the age of 18
sponsored.sum: Provides for a sex offender registry check for youth organization volunteers who have direct contact with youths under the age of 18.

sponsored.t: Requires police officers and peace officers to issue appearance tickets to individuals charged with certain offenses instead of arresting such individuals
sponsored.sum: Requires police officers and peace officers to issue appearance tickets to individuals charged with certain offenses instead of arresting such individuals.

sponsored.t: Relates to early decision admissions data reporting by colleges
sponsored.sum: Requires colleges and universities to report to the commissioner of education certain information relating to admission plans including early action, early decision and general admission.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of education to establish model codes of conduct on school property regarding cellphone use
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of education to establish model codes of conduct on school property regarding cellphone use.

sponsored.t: Prohibits food service establishments from modifying the purchase price of items based on consumer demand
sponsored.sum: Prohibits food service establishments from modifying the purchase price of items based on consumer demand except for when lowering the purchase price of a food or beverage item during specific times of the day.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of red dye 3 as a food additive or food color additive and the sale of food products containing red dye 3
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of red dye 3 as a food additive or food color additive and the sale of food products containing red dye 3 beginning January 1, 2027; provides that in an action to enforce compliance, the recognition by the federal food and drug administration of any of these substances as safe may not be alleged as a defense.

sponsored.t: Relates to required training for child protective services workers
sponsored.sum: Requires training in developmental disability awareness and sensitivity and cultural competency, sensitivity and implicit bias for child protective services workers.

sponsored.t: Prohibits a pharmacist from substituting any anti-epileptic drug for a prescribed anti-epileptic drug without the informed consent of the prescriber and patient
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a pharmacist from substituting any anti-epileptic drug for the prescribed anti-epileptic drug without notification of and the informed consent of the prescriber and patient or such patient's parent, guardian or spouse.

sponsored.t: Grants the attorney general jurisdiction to investigate and prosecute police misconduct
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the attorney general to investigate and prosecute the alleged commission of any criminal offense or offenses committed by police officers in connection with the performance of their regular duties.

sponsored.t: Relates to the execution of a warrant of arrest and establishes educational programs for judicial personnel on the law of searches, arrests and seizures
sponsored.sum: Relates to the execution of a warrant of arrest; authorizes the commissioner of the division of criminal justice services to establish a system to record and monitor the issuance and execution of search warrants; authorizes the chief administrator of the court system to establish educational programs for judicial personnel on the law of searches, arrests and seizures.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of the administration of children's services to obtain an order of consent before allowing experimental drug testing on certain children
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York city commissioner of the administration of children's services to obtain an order of consent from the court before allowing experimental drug testing on children under the care and/or control of the administration of children's services.

sponsored.t: Establishes an operation SNUG program
sponsored.sum: Establishes an "operation SNUG" program within the division of criminal justice services which provides grant awards to reduce, prevent or respond to gun violence.

sponsored.t: Prevents the overdetention of persons due to an outstanding warrant
sponsored.sum: Prevents the overdetention of persons due to an outstanding warrant from another jurisdiction.

sponsored.t: Requires New York city public school students are provided verbal and written warning of such student's right to refuse an interview and right to have a supportive adult during the interview
sponsored.sum: Requires the administration for children's services and New York city public school employees provide a verbal and written warning to students of such student's right to refuse an interview and right to have a supportive adult during the interview.

sponsored.t: Prohibits advertising for certain foods from being shown on television during certain hours
sponsored.sum: Prohibits advertising for certain junk foods from being shown on television between the hours of six A.M. and nine P.M.

sponsored.t: Establishes a registry of persons with sickle cell disease
sponsored.sum: Requires persons and parents of children who test positive for sickle cell disease are informed of such diagnosis and provided with educational materials; establishes a registry of persons with sickle cell disease; requires the department of health issue an annual report on sickle cell disease.

sponsored.t: Creates an exemption to the presumption that a child born in wedlock is the child of the birth parent's legal spouse
sponsored.sum: Creates an exemption to the presumption that a child born in wedlock is the child of the birth parent's legal spouse; permits certain actions to be taken by the birth parent without notice to the birth parent's legal spouse.

sponsored.t: Requires certain businesses licensed to practice appearance enhancement, cosmetology, and/or barbering provide adequate handwashing facilities and such facilities are used between clients
sponsored.sum: Requires certain businesses licensed to practice appearance enhancement, cosmetology, and/or barbering provide adequate handwashing facilities and such facilities are used between clients; requires gloves be provided.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of tobacco products and vapor products within five hundred feet of a public or private school
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of tobacco products and vapor products within five hundred feet of a public or private school.

sponsored.t: Requires state employees and certain public officials attend annual implicit bias training
sponsored.sum: Requires state employees and the governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, comptroller, and members of the legislature attend annual implicit bias training provided by the legislative ethics commission.

sponsored.t: Relates to producer responsibility
sponsored.sum: Enacts the affordable waste reduction act"; defines terms; provides for registration of producer responsibility organizations and service providers; establishes the producer responsibility advisory board; provides for department of environmental conservation responsibilities; provides for producer responsibility advisory board, organization, producer and service provider responsibilities; creates a recyclable or compostable covered materials lists and exempt materials list; establishes producer fees; provides for service provider reimbursement; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the student mental health apprenticeship retention and training (SMART) internship grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a student mental health apprenticeship retention and training (SMART) internship grant program; prescribes conditions for the administration of the student mental health apprenticeship retention and training (SMART) internship grant program; requires the promulgation of necessary rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Requires license plates for certain bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters and requires a person be eighteen years of age to operate or purchase bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters
sponsored.sum: Requires license plates for certain bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters; requires a person be eighteen years of age to operate or purchase bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters.

sponsored.t: Requires labels on certain foods and beverages containing harmful ingredients
sponsored.sum: Requires harmful ingredient labels on certain foods and beverages containing harmful ingredients; requires the creation of rules and regulations regarding the content and placement of harmful ingredient labels.

sponsored.t: Requires food service establishments disclose if they are operating out of another food service establishment's kitchen or in a location which is not operated exclusively as a kitchen for such establishment
sponsored.sum: Requires food service establishments disclose if they are operating out of another food service establishment's kitchen or in a location which is not operated exclusively as a kitchen for such establishment.

sponsored.t: Restricts a law enforcement officer from initiating a traffic stop for certain violations of the vehicle and traffic law
sponsored.sum: Restricts a law enforcement officer from initiating a traffic stop for certain violations of the vehicle and traffic law; provides for the suppression or exclusion of evidence obtained in violation of such provisions; relates to the duties of the division of criminal justice services making certain information pertaining to traffic stops public.

sponsored.t: Requires four hours of implicit bias training every two years for real estate appraisers
sponsored.sum: Requires four hours of implicit bias training every two years for real estate appraisers.

sponsored.t: Requires early voting occurs on the Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and Tuesdays prior to the election within the early voting period
sponsored.sum: Requires early voting occurs on the Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and Tuesdays prior to the election within the early voting period.

sponsored.t: Requires food products using ingredients classified as major food allergens to be labelled or branded as such
sponsored.sum: Requires food products using ingredients classified as major food allergens to be labelled or branded as such; requires food sellers to provide written notice to stores for food labels containing new ingredients classified as major food allergens; requires such foods are labeled or branded as such by a food seller until such food has appropriately labeled packaging.

sponsored.t: Relates to the automatic expungement of records of arrest
sponsored.sum: Provides for the automatic expungement of records of arrest in certain situations.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the requirement that a driver's license, professional license or recreational license be suspended for failing to pay child support
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the requirement that a driver's license, professional license or recreational license be suspended for failing to pay child support.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain housing accommodations
sponsored.sum: Provides that when a housing accommodation has been vacated after continuous tenancy or occupancy of ten years or more prior to vacancy, and the owner can demonstrate restoration of the unit, the new legal regulated rent shall be the rent agreed to by the owner and first tenant after such restoration and reserved in a lease or other rental agreement; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rental assistance payment standard pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the rental assistance payment standard pilot program where the owner of a housing accommodation shall be entitled to charge and collect a rent equal to the maximum amount that the rental assistance program prescribes for like housing accommodations, subject to rent reasonableness calculations.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale and display of symbols of hate by state funded entities or at state funded events
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale and display of symbols of hate by state funded entities or at state funded events.

sponsored.t: Removes cap on funds for teacher resource and computer training centers for city school district for the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Removes the cap on funds for teacher resource and computer training centers for the city school district for the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Imposes fines on businesses which are found to have card skimmers operating at such business
sponsored.sum: Imposes fines of up to ten thousand dollars per hour on businesses which are found to have skimming devices operating at such business for more than one hour.

sponsored.t: Directs condominium and cooperative housing associations to complete capital reserve studies
sponsored.sum: Directs condominium and cooperative housing associations to complete capital reserve studies, including a thirty-year funding plan, in order to ensure that the condominium or cooperative housing association has adequate reserve funds available to repair or replace the assets located on the property that the association is obligated to maintain without the need to create any special assessment or loan obligation; specifies the content of the study; requires the study to be filed with the state comptroller.

sponsored.t: Requires medical assistance to include medical care, services or supplies to monitor blood pressure that have been validated for accuracy and are furnished without prior authorization to eligible pregnant women
sponsored.sum: Requires medical assistance to include medical care, services or supplies to monitor blood pressure that have been validated for accuracy and are furnished without prior authorization to eligible pregnant women.

sponsored.t: Requires cosmetology licensees to disclose the price of cosmetology services at booking and prior to the start such services
sponsored.sum: Requires cosmetology licensees to disclose the price of cosmetology services at booking and prior to the start of such services.

sponsored.t: Prohibits correctional facilities from denying entry to certain peer support advocates based on such advocates' prior history of incarceration
sponsored.sum: Prohibits correctional facilities from denying entry to peer support advocates who are certified or licensed and are participating in the provision of corrections-based substance use disorder treatment and transition services based on such advocates' prior history of incarceration.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study of recess held in elementary schools in kindergarten through grade six
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to conduct a survey of recess held in public and charter schools serving students in kindergarten through grade six and to provide any information collected to the governor and the legislature.

sponsored.t: Relates to the debriefing of certain contracts
sponsored.sum: Provides that an unsuccessful offerer may additionally request a written explanation comparable to such debriefing to be provided by mail or electronic mail, which the state agency shall provide within sixty days of the offerer's request for a written explanation; lengthens the period in which a debriefing shall be requested by the unsuccessful offerer and the length of time in which a state agency must respond from 15 days to 30 days.

sponsored.t: Relates to training police officers on how to respond to situations involving individuals with autism spectrum disorder and other developmental disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to training police officers on how to respond to situations involving individuals with autism spectrum disorder and other developmental disabilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to notice requirements for bed bug infestation on rental residential premises
sponsored.sum: Requires landlords to notify adjoining units of a bed bug infestation in a rental residential premises without identifying information, and to notify all tenants of an infestation in a common area by posting such notice in a conspicuous location accessible to all tenants.
